headline: Wednesday slate: NLCS Game 3 (Brewers @ Dodgers, Milwaukee leads 2-0) and a small NHL card. The ALCS is tied 1-1 and resumes Thursday in Cleveland.

record.label: Yesterday (Tue 10/13)
record.note: Both Unders hit: Rays 3-1 and Avalanche 3-2, which also cashed the parlay. Peralta threw six shutout innings (18 outs). Hagel was held scoreless in a 4-1 loss. The Werenski assist props couldn't be confirmed. That's two straight winning days (+6.7u).

notes: No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3.
Two good days don't erase the earlier losses — keep stakes modest.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning. Prices marked 'estimate' weren't confirmed at a book — check yours.
Same-game parlay (SGP) prices are set by the book and pay less than the multiplied odds shown here.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Tuesday these went 4-0 with one unconfirmed. Today centers on Blake Snell at home.

straight.reasoning: Snell (1.90 ERA) had a 1.39 FIP over his final five starts and has allowed one run in 18 innings at Dodger Stadium since returning from the IL. The Dodgers are hitting .312 against Robert Gasser, and Milwaukee is weaker against lefties (97 wRC+ vs 112 against righties). LA is 12-3 in its last 15 home games. SI takes the run line, and Covers takes the moneyline (62%). At -180 the moneyline isn't worth it; plus money for a two-run win is. Playable to +115.

Both teams played Tuesday and traveled, Washington has the league's worst expected goals against and is expected to start its backup, and Montreal's Jakob Dobes has allowed 11 goals in his last two games. Covers' top pick. Price is an estimate; playable to -125.

props.reasoning: He allowed one run or fewer in each of his final eight regular-season starts (1.13 ERA) and one run in 18 innings at home since returning. His shaky Braves start still produced just one run despite five walks. SI's best prop. Playable to -150.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: NLCS Game 3: Brewers @ Dodgers, 5:00 PM PT on FS1. Robert Gasser (3.87 ERA) vs Blake Snell (1.90). Milwaukee leads 2-0 after winning 2-1 and 7-4. Odds: Dodgers -180, total 7.5. The ALCS is tied 1-1, with Game 3 Thursday in Cleveland.

straight.reasoning: Snell at home vs a Brewers lineup that's weaker against lefties, plus a .312 Dodgers average against Gasser. Playable to +115.

parlay.title: Snell Shuts the Door (SGP)
parlay.reasoning: If Snell keeps Milwaukee to a run or less, a two-run Dodgers win is much more likely. Correlated, so the book pays less than shown.

props.reasoning: One run or fewer in each of his last eight regular-season starts, and one run in 18 innings at home since returning. Playable to -150.

He's hitting .391 with three homers in six playoff games and has cleared this in three of his last four. Snell is a tough matchup, which is why it's a quarter unit, and it works against the Snell bet. Covers' prop. Price is an estimate; skip below +120.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: No games today. Thursday Night Football is tomorrow.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: Canadiens @ Capitals (4:30 PM PT) and Stars @ Avalanche (5:30). Both are rematches or second games of back-to-backs. Dallas is without Wyatt Johnston and starts backup Casey DeSmith at altitude. We're passing on Avalanche -160, since the model makes it only about 57%.

straight.reasoning: Tired legs on both sides, backup goalies likely, and Washington is the league's worst team by expected goals against. Price is an estimate; playable to -125.

sections.label: Basketball
sections.slate: No games today. The WNBA Finals (Valkyries vs Dream) start Saturday.
